row.title: Executor ladder: a model-level failure must not down the provider route
row.body: 13 of 30 executor runs failed because one 502 from workers-ai-glm marked the whole workers-ai route DOWN, so llama, qwen and gpt-oss were never asked; GitHub Models (retired 2026-07-30) answered 200 OK and was routed first. Fixed with route_down (provider-wide failures only), retired adapters never routed, content-null handling and two added Workers AI rungs; tests pass (53 ladder tests) and the two new models were probed live through the account AI endpoint.
